title: Staff Product Manager, SEO and AI Visibility - CANADA
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the SEO and AI visibility solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once.

The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.

This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one.

What You'll Do

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for

• Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance

• Productize what repeats. When the same issue or workflow shows up across the fleet, solve it once through better defaults, automation, shared capabilities, or safeguards

• Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines

• Run a real experimentation program: prove changes on representative cohorts of sites, establish incremental impact, then scale what works rather than shipping broadly and inferring impact afterward

• Own migration quality and regression prevention, including the standards, acceptance criteria, and automated checks that hold search quality as the platform ships

• Partner with the team building the next generation of our website platform so search is designed in from the start, and give every product team a low-friction path to the right implementation

• Set platform-level goals for organic performance, AI visibility, and client outcomes, and report against them to leadership

Who You Are

• 8+ years combined across SEO and product management, including 3+ years as a product manager shipping alongside engineering teams

• You have owned search for a platform that hosts many independent customer domains, such as a website builder, a hosting or commerce platform, or a multi-location or franchise network. Running search for one large marketplace or corporate domain is valuable experience, but the fleet problem is a different job and it is the one we have

• Deep technical foundation across rendering and JavaScript SEO, crawl and index management, information architecture, structured data, page performance, and migrations

• You treat bots and AI agents as users of a website alongside people, and you design for both without trading one against the othe

title: Layout Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Layout Engineer to join our design team and support the development of layouts for photonic integrated circuits. You will maintain our layout infrastructure, help translate new designs into fabrication-ready layouts, and contribute to the implementation of new design rules and verification flows.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Maintain and further develop our layout libraries and workflows in Synopsys

- Support designers in generating layouts for new photonic devices and circuits

title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer-from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems , we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond-all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Systems Software Engineer, you will closely collaborate with fellow engineers and product managers to make Espresso a reality. Your focus will be on the transaction processing, communication, consensus, and storage components of the ledger and roll-up systems, while using the cryptography library developed by our cryptography team.
Responsibilities

• Contribute to the design and implementation of Espresso’s core blockchain infrastructure in Rust

• Take engineering projects from concept and design to production, while working with engineering leaders and the product team to create sound and realistic roadmaps

Requirements

• B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or relevant field, or equivalent computer science and software engineering experience

• Experience shipping and taking engineering projects to production

• Experience with distributed systems and/or blockchain systems, especially P2P networking and consensus

• Understanding of software engineering and security best practices

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Passion for writing correct code

Preferred

• Proficiency with Rust in a production environment (or similar strongly-typed languages such as C++, Haskell, Ocaml, etc.)

• Experience working on blockchain infrastructure, e.g. a layer-1 blockchain

• Enthusiasm for the rapidly developing blockchain ecosystem

Benefits

• Fully remote with flexible hours

Artemis seeks a Change Management Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. Change Deliverables. Create communication plans, roadmaps, coaching plans, training plans, and resistance management plans.

•
Stakeholder Management. Identify and analyze stakeholders across VHA Central Office, Veterans Integrated Service Networks (VISNs), and VA medical centers, and support and engage senior leaders.

•
Resistance Management. Identify and manage anticipated resistance, including in union environments.

• Experience applying change management in a union environment.

• Experience with change management for health care organizations, including EHR transitions.

• Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams.

About this opportunity
G2i is hiring on behalf of one of our clients, a fast-growing, DC-based government services firm. Since 2009 they have helped federal agencies and large government primes in three areas: research and data analysis, advanced data science, and strategic services. They currently support several analytics and research programs across HHS. The team is collaborative and small enough that your work is visible, and they take work-life balance seriously.
You'd be hired through G2i and work embedded with the client's team.
The role
You'll own the product roadmap for the client's document intelligence platform. You'll turn customer and reviewer needs into clear, testable requirements and make sure each problem is fixed in the right place. That could be the UX, the source data, the extraction pipeline, the model, the search logic, the thresholds, or the business rules.
This role suits a product leader who knows that AI products need measurable definitions of quality: accuracy, false-positive rates, reviewer effort, evidence requirements and operational performance.
What you'll do

• Own the roadmap and priorities across data engineering, data science, backend, search and frontend teams

• Lead discovery with clients and internal stakeholders using prototypes, demos and working software

• Turn business needs into requirements, user stories, business rules and measurable acceptance criteria

• Define requirements for document processing, alerts, scoring, evidence presentation, search, review workflows and source traceability

• Work with data scientists on evaluation datasets, model metrics, confidence thresholds, and acceptable false-positive and false-negative rates

• Work with data engineers on ingestion, normalization, metadata, lineage, processing completeness and data quality

• Diagnose whether an issue comes from the UI, data, model, pipeline, search, thresholds or business rules

• Favor reusable platform capabilities over one-off client customizations

• Coordinate release readiness, client demos and structured feedback

• Measure accuracy, completeness, reviewer effort, latency, reliability, adoption and cost

• Communicate priorities, tradeoffs and limitations clearly to clients and internal teams

What you bring

• Senior PM experience delivering AI/ML, data-intensive, search or workflow products

• Experience prioritizing work across data, ML, backend and frontend teams

• A track record of discovery driven by prototypes or demos

• Skill turning business needs into detailed, technical, testable requirements

• Experience defining acceptance criteria for probabilistic features such as model outputs, alerts, recommendations or rankings

• A solid grasp of data pipelines, APIs, data quality, system dependencies and model behavior

• Close working experience with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers and UX

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, writing and decision-making

Requirements

• Authorized to work in the US, with 3+ consecutive years living in the US

• Able and willing to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Nice to have

• Document intelligence, OCR, semantic or vector search, generative AI, or human-in-the-loop workflows

• Products built on AWS (e.g. S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract)

• Regulated, healthcare, medical-device or other high-stakes products

• Model governance, explainability, evidence traceability and reviewer workflows

• Supporting multiple clients while keeping one coherent, reusable roadmap

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us - it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds - they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them - so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

This application is for established coders with 8+ years of experience who will breeze through live coding interviews and it does not require active clearance but you must be eligible. 

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
About Tiugo
Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000. Formed in 2021 and backed by PSG, we have grown through acquisition into a ~$60M ARR business with strong gross and net retention and Rule of 60 performance.
We run two motions at once: a developer-led, product-led motion at high volume, and sales-led motion with a growing enterprise model built around our AI content platform. Our next chapter depends on running both well, across multiple brands, with one set of numbers everybody trusts.
Why this role exists now
Over the next eighteen months we are layering an enterprise, AI-led motion on top of an inbound Sales Assist motion and a product-led engine, across four brands with four histories and four stacks. That demands a revenue operations function that designs the engine rather than maintains it. One that owns how a customer moves from first touch through renewal, how we measure it, how we equip the field to run it, and how we automate the parts that should not need a human. The clearest example is renewals: moving the long tail to a tech-touch motion where people manage by exception, designed hand in hand with our Customer Success leaders. We are deliberately not backfilling the role as it existed. This is a bigger job, and we are hiring for the version of it we need in FY27.
In place today: a RevOps team; standardized stage and data definitions across instances; a weekly forecast cadence; a self-service channel; a central data warehouse.
What you'll build: field enablement, a deal desk, GTM engineering, a scaled tech-touch renewal motion, and real business analysis.
What you will own

• The revenue engine's architecture. In close collaboration with the CRO and Sales & CS leaders, design the end-to-end customer journey across self-service and sales-assisted motions: segmentation, coverage, routing, lifecycle stages, and the handoffs between marketing, sales, customer success and partners.

• Sales, customer success and partner operations. A single operations function serving the whole revenue motion. One funnel, one definition set, one system of record. This covers every Tiugo brand, and you decide where standardization pays off and where a lighter touch is right. Marketing operations sits today within Growth Marketing and works closely with this role on the shared funnel. As the function matures, bringing the two closer together is a path we'll consider.

• Planning and performance cadence. Territory and coverage design, quota setting, capacity and productivity modeling, and the forecast process and its discipline. You design the incentive plans; Finance administers and pays them.

• Deal desk. A function that works inside the deal cycle alongside our sellers, helping shape deal structure and pricing approach on enterprise and AI deals, and moving those deals through legal, finance and security review without losing momentum. It also brings together the sales support work that keeps deals moving, such as quoting. Finance and Legal keep their approval authority; this role owns the path to it. You will define how the function operates as part of building it.

• Field enablement. Onboarding and ramp, sales methodology, and product and AI fluency across the field. This is a build rather than a maintain, and you will hire the leader for it.

• GTM engineering and applied AI. In collaboration with a central AI team, own Revenue Organization automation across the revenue lifecycle and internal AI applications pointed at go-to-market work.

• Business analysis for the revenue engine. Not report production, but interpretation. Monitoring what the business is actually doing, diagnosing what changed and why, and turning that into recommendations the revenue leadership team acts on. title: Senior People Partner
description:
Senior People Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £60,000 - £70,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 200 people can break when growth accelerates - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS NOW

Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. We have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our People function to ensure the business hits those goals.

THE ROLE

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.

Over the next 12-18 months, this will mean you'll be working with our Head of People and People Partner on initiatives that clarify excellence and reward - our internal levels framework, compensation & reward, embedding our excellence standard throughout the business, coaching senior managers and leaders, and building manager capability at scale.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A Senior People Partner with experience operating at this level: you’ve designed people systems built for growth, coached senior managers and leaders, are curious about how technology and innovation is changing the People landscape, and are constantly looking for more impactful ways to support the business.

- A commercial mindset - e.g. you measure your results on impact on business and team performance rather than work shipped.

- An AI-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you - but understand the nuances of where AI can never replace genuine People Partnering.

- The credibility and communication skills to bring busy managers on the journey with you.

- Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.

WHY YOU MIGHT NOT WANT TO APPLY

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

- If you want to move into people management. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.

- If you haven't been through a similar scaling journey in SaaS businesses before. Our People team is home grown; we're specifically looking for the experience and knowledge that comes from having been there/done that before, and can prevent us from making common mistakes.

- If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

At Artemis (artemispower.com), we're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of solar, storage, EV charging, and home improvements by making them more accessible, transparent, and affordable. Founded in 2022, we're a venture-backed climate tech company using machine learning and AI to reinvent how homeowners upgrade their homes - a market orders of magnitude bigger than solar alone. Our platform generates instant, accurate proposals and streamlines the sales process for homeowners and installers alike.

We're a fast-growing, dynamic startup moving quickly - shipping new products, entering adjacent categories, and expanding the platform every quarter. If you want broad surface area, fast feedback loops, and real ownership, this is the place.

Our values

•
Challenge Assumptions. Creatively find better ways of working.

•
Stop, Look, Listen, and Smell. Pay attention before you act - gather context, read the room.

•
Move Fast. Thoughtfully prioritize work.

•
Be Scrappy. View problems as opportunities; stay lean.

•
Always be Learning. Stay curious; invest in your craft.

Do the Right Thing. Keep commitments, close the loop.

The role

Support Engineers sit at L2 in our support stack - L1 (Technical Support Representatives) handle direct customer contact, you're the technical responder they lean on, and L3 (senior engineers) is where you escalate when a problem needs deeper investigation. You'll run technical investigations, ship bug fixes, and keep L1 unblocked so customers stay unblocked. Because support touches every part of the product, you'll build broad familiarity across the codebase and work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.

The shift for this position is 3PM-11PM ET weekdays, with on-call every other Saturday 10am-3pm ET.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as the primary technical responder on your assigned support shifts - this is an L2 role, so most tickets reach you via escalation from L1, not directly from customers.

• Partner with Customer Success and Product to turn customer context into the right fix.

• 5+ years of experience in an engineering or technical support role in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Comfortable in a modern web stack - Next.js, React, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.

• Working knowledge of SQL and a scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar).

• Hands-on with testing and monitoring tools like Postman, PostHog, CloudWatch, Sentry, or equivalents.

• Experience with support ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, Linear, or similar).

• Strong written communication - you can explain a technical problem to both a customer and a senior engineer.

• Thrives in a fast-moving, dynamic startup environment - comfortable with shifting priorities and ambiguity.

• Hands-on experience with AI development tools and workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) for investigation, debugging, and shipping fixes faster.

What we offer

• Fully remote work.

• Stock options.

• Health benefits.

• Paid time off and vacations.

• Annual tech allowance.

• Professional development through courses, seminars, and certifications.

title: Sr. Specialist, Advanced Analytics
description:
The Sr. Specialist, Advanced Analytics is a seasoned expert in statistical modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics who operates with a high degree of autonomy to design, build, and deploy sophisticated analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of advanced models - including customer lifetime value, churn prediction, propensity modeling, and advanced segmentation - and serves as a trusted analytical advisor to business stakeholders and senior leadership. The Sr. Specialist is expected to bring deep technical mastery combined with strong business judgment, translating ambiguous business problems into well-defined analytical frameworks and translating complex model outputs into clear, actionable strategic recommendations. This individual also plays a key role in elevating the capability of the broader analytics team through mentorship, best-practice development, and technical leadership.
Here’s what you’ll do:

• Lead the full analytical project lifecycle - from problem framing and data exploration through model development, validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Partner directly with business stakeholders and cross-functional leaders to identify high-value analytical opportunities, scope projects, and align modeling approaches with strategic business objectives.

• Translate complex statistical and machine learning outputs into clear, non-technical narratives and actionable recommendations for executive and business audiences.

• Proactively identify data quality issues, model drift, or emerging risks in production models and lead remediation efforts.

• Independently design, develop, and deploy advanced predictive and machine learning models (e.g., customer lifetime value, churn, propensity-to-buy, next-best-action, advanced segmentation) with minimal oversight.

• Establish and maintain model governance practices, including documentation, validation standards, and monitoring frameworks to ensure models remain accurate and reliable in production.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level analysts on statistical techniques, coding best practices, model validation methods, and business communication skills.

• Lead or significantly contribute to large, cross-team analytical initiatives, often coordinating work across multiple contributors and stakeholders.

• Stay current on emerging SnowFlake, SQL, Databricks, emerging AI and machine learning techniques, tools, and industry best practices, and champion their adoption where relevant.

• Collaborate with data engineering and IT teams to ensure analytical infrastructure, data pipelines, and tooling support scalable model development and deployment.

• Present findings, methodologies, and business impact to senior leadership and various cross-functional partners.
What you’ll need to be successful:

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field required; Master's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• 3 - 5 years of progressive experience in statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or data science, with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex analytical solutions.

• Advanced, demonstrated expertise in machine learning algorithms (e.g., gradient boosting, random forests, clustering, survival analysis) and statistical modeling techniques.

• Expert-level proficiency in R and/or Python, with strong SQL skills; experience with cloud-based or enterprise analytical infrastructure strongly preferred.

• Proven experience building and deploying customer lifetime value, churn, and segmentation models in a production business environment.

• Strong business acumen with the demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into strategic, actionable business recommendations.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior business stakeholders

title: Senior Software Developer, Dataplane Adapters
description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model - it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.
Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide - including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more - have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.
So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology-and your hard work!
About the Role
We at Solace believe we build the world's best event broker - the backbone of real-time business, trusted to move billions of messages a day across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments with unmatched reliability and performance.
At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the Datapath - the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. This work spans our custom hardware appliance - built around FPGAs and a Cavium network processor - and our software broker running on Intel server processors. The code is highly multi-threaded and performance-oriented, and our developers regularly go deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals to deliver features that meet our strict performance and reliability bar.
This position is for a Senior Software Developer on the Dataplane Adapters team. In this role you will be a key technical leader who contributes to the architecture of our protocol adapters and leads the design and delivery of the most complex features for how clients connect to the broker. You will shape technical direction across the hardware and software platforms, mentor other developers, represent the team with customers and other R&D groups, and be a go-to person for the hardest performance and field problems. Your expertise will shape how the world's largest enterprises move their most critical data.
Are You Someone Who:

• Has a passion for high-performance systems with a deep understanding of multi-threaded C++, TCP/IP, and the Linux kernel?

• Thrives on solving complex protocol and performance challenges in distributed messaging systems?

• Has experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems?

• Enjoys mentoring and leading technical teams while contributing to architectural decisions?

• Values craftsmanship, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences?

• Is humble, honest and open?

What You'll Do:

• Lead Adapter Design: Contribute to the architecture of our protocol adapters, lead the design and technical delivery of the most complex features across the hardware appliance and software broker, and own the technical decisions within those features

• Drive Technical Innovation: Research and prototype new protocol features, networking techniques, and performance approaches to keep the Solace datapath ahead of the industry

• Develop Core Platform Features: Design and build the most complex, performance-critical adapter features in multi-threaded C++, going deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals when needed

• Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to intermediate and junior developers, lead design and code reviews, and establish best practices for the team, including how we use AI-assisted development in performance-critical code

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with product management,
